mapper.select: SELECT ds.scope_type, rds.organization_id FROM system_user_role ur JOIN system_role r ON r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 JOIN system_role_data_scope rds ON rds.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND rds.role_id = r.id AND rds.deleted = 0 JOIN system_data_scope ds ON ds.tenant_id = rds.tenant_id AND ds.id = rds.data_scope_id AND ds.status = 1 AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT managed.organization_id FROM ( SELECT relation.organization_id FROM organization_manager_relation relation JOIN organization organization_row ON organization_row.tenant_id = relation.tenant_id AND organization_row.id = relation.organization_id AND organization_row.status = 1 AND organization_row.deleted = 0 WHERE relation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND relation.user_id = #{userId} AND relation.deleted = 0 UNION SELECT organization_row.id AS organization_id FROM organization organization_row WHERE organization_row.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND organization_row.manager_user_id = #{userId} AND organization_row.status = 1 AND organization_row.deleted = 0 ) managed
